project.project_name: Vega Acquisition Integration — Regulatory Reporting Modernization [71C27]

content.rationale: IT Gate (framing) against authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_IT: exactly one triggered finding. Technology reaches end-of-life in 4 months (< 12), so IT-EOL-001 applies with disposition REWORK and action CREATE_CONVERGENCE_PLAN owned by the Technology Owner. All other predicates are clean: catalog_status=standard with waiver_present=true, duplicate_capability=false, license_compliant=true, cmdb_record_present=true, run_owner_present=true, change_record_status=approved. Capacity headroom is 15% (not < 15) and, being phase=framing, IT-CAPACITY-001, IT-CMDB-001 and IT-RUN-001 are not applicable. LIFECYCLE_REGISTER and TECH_CATALOG are UNAVAILABLE, but the designated authoritative snapshot supplies the governing values. Gate disposition is driven by the highest-severity triggered finding (REWORK); REWORK is not an authorization-required disposition under the standing mandate, which covers only risk-acceptable findings.

Architecture Gate (design) evaluated against the authoritative snapshot REVIEW_FACTS_ARCHITECTURE (v1, age 0 days). Two predicates fire. (1) ARCH-HA-001 (high): project business_criticality = "High" while architecture_profile shows "multi_az": false and "multi_region": false — a High-criticality workload with no zone or regional redundancy; this matches the HLD, which is explicitly labelled "Single-AZ / no AZ guarantee" and "No dedicated DR region". Action REDESIGN_FOR_HIGH_AVAILABILITY, owner Solution Architect, disposition REWORK, risk acceptance not allowed. (2) ARCH-REV-001 (medium): "reversibility_status": "missing", so the reversibility/exit design is incomplete; action COMPLETE_EXIT_ARCHITECTURE, owner Enterprise Architect, disposition GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS (risk-acceptable). Remaining predicates are clean and therefore not raised: ip_overlap = false (corroborated by authoritative IP_PLAN, all three CIDRs overlap_detected "False"), api_gateway_required = true with api_gateway_present = true (Azure API Management instances present in the HLD), data_owner_present = true with data_lineage_complete = true, and measured_latency_ms 180 <= latency_target_ms 200. Per the priority ladder, the highest triggered disposition governs the gate, so the overall disposition is REWORK rather than GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS. REWORK is not among the authorization-required dispositions (GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, SUSPENSION, NO_GO), so authorization_required = false; the standing mandate MANDATE-5d8bb3b5...-INTEGRATE-02-ARCHITECTURE-1 covers only risk-acceptable findings and is not exercised here. These are proposed remediation actions, not completed remediation. Upstream INTEGRATE-01-IT-1 returned REWORK for IT-EOL-001 (technology EOL in 4 months); that is a separate IT-gate item and does not alter this architecture determination.

Security Architecture Gate (design) evaluated against the authoritative snapshot REVIEW_FACTS_SECURITY (v1, age 0 days). Three predicates fire. (1) SEC-VULN-001 (critical): snapshot reports \"critical_vulns_open\": 2, corroborated by authoritative VULN_SCAN listing CVE-2026-8000 and CVE-2026-8001 as severity Critical / status Open. Action REMEDIATE_CRITICAL_VULNERABILITIES, owner Product Team, disposition NO_GO, risk acceptance not allowed. (2) SEC-IAM-002 (high): \"shared_service_principal\": true, corroborated by authoritative IAM_EXPORT showing principal \"workload-mi\" as a ManagedIdentity with \"shared\": true at \"scope\": \"subscription\" — a single shared identity spanning workloads rather than a dedicated workload identity. Action CREATE_DEDICATED_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY, owner IAM Team, disposition REWORK, risk acceptance not allowed. (3) SEC-LOG-001 (high): \"logs_to_siem\": false while \"sentinel\": true, corroborated by authoritative SENTINEL_STATUS with \"logs_to_siem\": false and an empty connectors list — Sentinel is provisioned but no security-relevant logs are exported. Action CONNECT_LOGS_TO_SIEM, owner SOC, disposition REWORK, risk acceptance not allowed. Predicates that do NOT fire and are therefore not raised: WAF is present in \"waf_mode\": \"Prevention\" (confirmed by WAF_POLICY \"mode\": \"Prevention\") so SEC-WAF-001/SEC-WAF-002 are clean; data_classification is \"Internal\" (not Confidential/Restricted) and \"private_endpoints\": true so SEC-NET-001 is clean; \"mfa\": \"mandatory\" so SEC-IAM-001 is clean; \"key_rotation_days\": 90 (not None or 365) so SEC-KEY-001 is clean; and SEC-PENTEST-001 is phase-gated to build_acceptance and does not apply in design, with \"pentest_status\": \"pass\" and \"pentest_age_days\": 14 in any case. Per the priority ladder the highest triggered disposition governs, so the gate disposition is NO_GO (driven by SEC-VULN-001). NO_GO is an authorization-required disposition, but no authorization can be granted here: the active standing mandate MANDATE-5d8bb3b5-f441-5613-97ae-b69c2f6113ad-INTEGRATE-03-SECURITY-1 is scoped to \"all and only risk-acceptable findings\", and all three findings carry risk_acceptance_allowed=false, so the mandate is not exercised and no conditional approval is attempted. Upstream INTEGRATE-02-ARCHITECTURE-1 returned REWORK for ARCH-HA-001 and ARCH-REV-001; those are separate architecture-gate items and do not alter this security determination. These are proposed remediation actions, not completed remediation.

Legal Gate (design) evaluated against the authoritative snapshot REVIEW_FACTS_LEGAL (v1, age 0 days). Exactly one predicate fires. LEGAL-LOG-001 (high): the snapshot reports \"log_export_clause\": \"missing\" while project \"business_criticality\": \"High\", matching the rule condition (log_export_clause == 'missing' and business_criticality in High/Critical). This is corroborated by the MSA, whose Security clause states \"Security logs export: missing\", and by the authoritative CONTRACT_PLAYBOOK, which requires \"security_log_export\": \"included for high/critical services\". Action ADD_LOG_EXPORT_CLAUSE, owner Legal, disposition REWORK, risk acceptance allowed. All other predicates are clean and therefore not raised: personal_data = true but \"dpa_status\": \"signed\" (DPA-001 not fired); \"liability_cap_multiplier\": 1 with \"security_carveout\": true (LIAB-001 not fired); \"audit_right\": \"full\" (AUDIT-001 not fired); \"exit_assistance_days\": 90 (EXIT-001 not fired); \"ip_ownership\": \"customer\" (IP-001 not fired); \"insurance_valid\": true (INS-001 not fired); \"signing_authority_valid\": true (SIGN-001 not fired). Per the priority ladder the highest triggered disposition governs, so the gate disposition is REWORK. REWORK is not among the authorization-required dispositions (GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, SUSPENSION, NO_GO), so authorization_required = false; the standing mandate MANDATE-5d8bb3b5-f441-5613-97ae-b69c2f6113ad-INTEGRATE-04-LEGAL-1 (scoped to risk-acceptable findings) is not exercised. Upstream INTEGRATE-02-ARCHITECTURE-1 (REWORK) and INTEGRATE-03-SECURITY-1 (NO_GO) are separate gate items and do not alter this legal determination. These are proposed remediation actions, not completed remediation.

Compliance Gate (design) evaluated against the authoritative snapshot REVIEW_FACTS_COMPLIANCE (v1, age 0 days). Two predicates fire. (1) COMP-A11Y-001 (high): \"accessibility_status\": \"major_findings\" — the accessibility assessment contains major findings. Action REMEDIATE_ACCESSIBILITY, owner Product Team, disposition REWORK, risk acceptance allowed. (2) COMP-EXPORT-002 (high): \"export_control\": \"pending\" — export-control screening is not yet complete. Action COMPLETE_EXPORT_CONTROL_REVIEW, owner Compliance, disposition SUSPENSION, risk acceptance not allowed. Predicates that do NOT fire and are therefore not raised: dpia_required = true but \"dpia_status\": \"complete\" (COMP-DPIA-001 clean, corroborated by DPIA \"Status | complete\"); \"residency_compliant\": true with required_residency \"EU\" and DATA_INVENTORY actual_region \"West Europe\" (COMP-RESID-001 clean); \"audit_trail\": \"partial\" (not \"missing\", so COMP-AUDIT-001 clean); \"regulatory_mapping\": \"partial\" (not \"missing\", so COMP-MAP-001 clean, corroborated by REG_MAPPING mapping_status \"partial\"); \"export_control\" is \"pending\" not \"restricted\", so COMP-EXPORT-001 does not fire. Per the priority ladder the highest triggered disposition governs, so the gate disposition is SUSPENSION (driven by COMP-EXPORT-002), which outranks the REWORK from COMP-A11Y-001. SUSPENSION is an authorization-required disposition, but no authorization can be granted here: the active standing mandate MANDATE-5d8bb3b5-f441-5613-97ae-b69c2f6113ad-INTEGRATE-05-COMPLIANCE-1 is scoped to \"all and only risk-acceptable findings\", and COMP-EXPORT-002 carries risk_acceptance_allowed=false, so the mandate is not exercised and no conditional approval is attempted. Upstream INTEGRATE-02-ARCHITECTURE-1 (REWORK), INTEGRATE-03-SECURITY-1 (NO_GO) and INTEGRATE-04-LEGAL-1 (REWORK) are separate gate items and do not alter this compliance determination. These are proposed remediation actions, not completed remediation.
